title: Smashed Buttery Mushy Peas
summary: Frozen peas cooked soft in butter and water, smashed to a chunky purée and finished with lemon zest and a butter pat.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Cook the peas
steps.text: Put the peas, 45 g butter, 60 ml water and salt in the saucepan, cover and cook over medium heat for 12-15 min, stirring once or twice. They should be very soft and squash easily against the side of the pan; cooking past tender is what lets them break down.

steps.title: Smash
steps.text: Remove the lid and mash with the potato masher to a chunky purée, leaving some peas whole for texture.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir in the lemon zest and pepper, adding 2-3 tbsp water if the purée is too thick. Taste for salt and serve with a pat of butter melting on top.

tips: Keep the lid on while cooking so the water does not boil away.
For a smoother result, pulse briefly in a food processor instead of mashing.
A little chopped mint is a classic addition.
The chip-shop style is made with dried marrowfat peas soaked overnight.
storage: Refrigerate covered up to 3 days, or freeze up to 2 months. Reheat in a pan with a splash of water until piping hot (74 °C). Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
